statement: Pinned Dolphin's Wii Remote calibration helper calculates its one-byte checksum as a byte-wise sum over the preceding calibration bytes initialized with 0x55. When a calibration block reserves two checksum bytes, the second is the first checksum advanced by another 0x55 (mod 256). Its EEPROM templates use one byte, while Nunchuk/Classic extension templates use two. This is Dolphin's source-model checksum algorithm, not a physical-device validation.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: WiimoteEmu.h 76-95; Nunchuk.cpp 138-143; Classic.cpp 170-175; no factory bytes published.
